description: Ministry of  Mahaweli Development and Environment -  Order to Prohibit the use of Polyethylene products as decorations
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that establishes a new prohibition under the National Environmental Act. It cites specific legal authority (Section 23W of Act No. 47 of 1980 and Section 51 of the Nineteenth Amendment to the Constitution) and creates a binding regulatory requirement prohibiting the use of certain plastic products for decoration in various events. While it mentions the President's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create a regulation, not a personnel appointment or government restructuring, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
